description: The meeting of the Rotary Club of Mumbai Bravehearts commenced with a welcome, the Bravehearts National Anthem Video, and the Four-Way Test. Chief Guest PDG Rtn. Dr. Bal Inamdar and AG Rtn. Ritu Bagla were welcomed to the dais, followed by the Bravehearts Rotary Video. Outgoing President Rtn. Zeenat delivered her speech and presentation, followed by recognitions, acknowledgement of project partners, and the Regal Anthem Video. Rtn. Bhakti Sharma was introduced by IPP Rtn. Zeenat and formally inducted as President, followed by her acceptance speech. The Club Bulletin was launched, and the Board of Directors and new members were inducted, followed by the Oath Ceremony. AG Rtn. Ritu Bagla addressed the gathering, followed by an address from Chief Guest PDG Rtn. Dr. Bal Inamdar. Secretarial announcements were made by Rtn. Tasneem Loliwala, followed by the Vote of Thanks by President Elect Rtn. Nishchit Shetty and formal adjournment.
